editorial.name: Claude Design
editorial.descriptionZh: Claude 里专做设计产出的那一块：描述一个原型、幻灯片或单页，它先出草稿，再交给你自己或 Claude Code 继续改。
editorial.takeawayZh: 一句话出原型草稿，可交接给 Claude Code 继续改
editorial.noteZh: 这个页面渲染完整，没被挡住。面包屑是 Product / Claude Design，首屏正中是 Your idea, designed with Claude，副标题写着 Explore more directions than a deadline allows；右下角浮着一张新品卡，标题是 Claude Design stays on brand for daily work，正文列 New design system import、editor and Claude Code sync、higher shared limits、more connected apps，按钮 See what's new。导航把 Claude Design 与 Claude Code、Claude Cowork、Claude Science、Claude Security 并列成同级产品，正文 How it works 之后收在 Start your next design with Claude。
editorial.pricing: Included with a paid Claude plan (Pro and above)

reasons.statement: 交付物是设计草稿而非组件代码：首屏写 Describe a prototype, deck, or one-pager, and Claude builds a draft，动作是先出草稿再自己改，属于原型类工具。
正文明确写了交接动作 hand it off to your tools or Claude Code，所以它落在设计阶段而非建站交付类。
